newsitem.title: BRAZIL: FOREIGNERS NET SELLERS OF SAO PAULO STOCKS IN AUG.
newsitem.headline: FOREIGNERS NET SELLERS OF SAO PAULO STOCKS IN AUG.

text.p: The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) saw net foreign capital outflows of 68.04 million reais in the first eight days of August, the bolsa said.
Foreign purchases totalled 1.188 billion reais, against foreign sales of 1.256 billion reais in the period, it said in a statement.
Traders said the result was no surprise as foreigners traditionally stay on the sidelines before futures and options settlements.
The futures index contracts are due to be liquidated today, while options will settle next Monday.
So far this year, net foreign investment in the Sao Paulo bourse has totalled 1.761 billion reais, the bolsa said.
